command: llvm-mc -triple=x86_64 -filetype=obj P9.asm -o out.o && llvm-objcopy -O binary --only-section=.text out.o out.bin
notes: One operation, `movaps` at `xmm` width, in three encoding families. The assembled part is `movaps %xmm1,%xmm0` -> `0f 28 c1` (no prefix) and `vmovaps %xmm3,%xmm2` -> `c5 f8 28 d3` (two-byte VEX); the appended `62 f1 7c 08 28 e5` is the EVEX.128 encoding of `vmovaps %xmm5,%xmm4`, which llvm-mc will not select from a mnemonic but decodes to the same instruction. The three byte strings differ only in the prefix family and the ModRM position, so the family is a form fact.
